title: Quiz: Naming and Readable Code
description: Check your understanding of Naming and Readable Code.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in TypeScript?
questions.explanation: In TypeScript, // marks a comment. Block comments use /* */.

questions.question: Which name is best for a function that checks email format?
questions.explanation: Names should reveal purpose — isValidEmail says exactly what it answers.

questions.question: True or False: Comments should explain WHAT the code does line by line.
questions.explanation: This statement is incorrect — review the lesson.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: const MAX_RETRIES = 3  // name ___ numbers
questions.explanation: Named constants replace unexplained literal values.

questions.question: In TypeScript, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
